title: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021
what_it_is: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021

sections.label: COVID-19 support budget increases
sections.summary: Three sums are moved: $500 million for a Foreign Worker Levy Rebate, $200 million for loan scheme enhancements, and $4 billion for Special Transfers.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated to Head S of the Main Estimates be increased by $500,000,000." The increase is to provide employers with a Foreign Worker Levy Rebate as announced in the Deputy Prime Minister's Ministerial Statement on 6 April 2020, to temporarily ease the labour costs of affected firms.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated to Head V of the Development Estimates be increased by $200,000,000." The increase is for further enhancements to the Temporary Bridging Loan Programme, Enterprise Financing Scheme, or EFS – SME Working Capital Loan, and EFS – Trade Loan, as announced in Deputy Prime Minister's Ministerial Statement on 6 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated to Head Z of the Main Estimates be increased by $4,000,000,000." The increase is for additional Special Transfers as announced in Deputy Prime Minister's Ministerial Statement on 6 April 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Of the increase, $2.9 billion is for the enhancements to the Jobs Support Scheme; and $1.1 billion is for the one-off Solidarity Payment to households during this period.
